richiami.difetto: Due to a manufacturing error an ‘inside’ sidewall marking has been printed on the outer sidewall on some tyres. The 'inside' marking should not be printed on directional tyres at all.
richiami.modello: 195/60 R15 (88H) Rovelo All Weather R4S , 195/60 R15 (88H) Rovelo All Weather R4S
richiami.rimedio: Replace the incorrectly marked tyre with a new tyre.
richiami.titolo: Rovelo All Weather 4RS tyres - displaying incorrect directional marking
